    read_line_to_string(current_input, S0),
    (   S0 == end_of_file
    ->  true

        string_codes(S, Codes),
        reverse(Codes, Reversed),
        (   Codes = Reversed

    ).

    string_codes(S0, Codes0),

    ->  string_codes(S, Codes)
    ;   S = S0
    ).
